maturityModel.promotionRule: A module may advance only through a reviewed PR when the required evidence is recorded in ops/module-governance/promotion-evidence.json. A main merge never changes its state or activates a capability.
maturityModel.adminVisibility: Technical state is informational only; authorization, feature flags and module availability remain the enforcement mechanisms.

purpose: Versioned operational contract for every product and cross-cutting Skincos module. An unavailable module-wide flag is recorded as a release gap, never implied to exist.

dataOwnership: Campaign configuration, reporting aggregates and raw Meta report payloads

featureFlag.enforcement: No module-wide flag exists; any new public or mutating capability must introduce a disabled-by-default flag before production.

modules.fallback: Keep prior reporting snapshots available and stop ingestion; CRM treats stale reporting as degraded, never as zero performance.

slo.measurement: Worker health and CRM reporting smoke

modules.rollback: Re-promote the previous immutable Worker artifact; preserve D1/R2 data and disable new consumers before replaying imports.

dataOwnership: HTTP transport, authentication boundary, request correlation and error envelopes; no domain business data
datastores: Cloudflare rate limiter and queue bindings

featureFlag.enforcement: The gateway has no module-wide flag; new routes require a domain flag or explicit release gate before production.

modules.fallback: Fail closed with the standard error envelope; do not proxy unknown or unavailable domain routes.

slo.measurement: GET /health, gateway tests and uptime monitor

modules.rollback: Promote the previous immutable Worker version; preserve bindings and revert only additive routing changes.

dataOwnership: Availability, booking requests, reservations and booking audit state

featureFlag.enforcement: No module-wide booking flag is present; new booking flows must ship disabled until an approved pilot is enabled.

modules.fallback: Expose a controlled manual-contact path and preserve the request for operator recovery; never create a duplicate reservation on retry.

slo.measurement: Website release check and booking status probe

modules.rollback: Promote the previous website/booking artifact and disable the new flow; keep additive D1 schema and reconcile pending requests manually.

dataOwnership: Customer, lead, operator identity, permissions and CRM operational state

featureFlag.enforcement: The console has per-capability gates but no single CRM module flag; new modules must be hidden and server-denied until explicitly released.

modules.fallback: Keep authenticated core CRM available, isolate an unhealthy optional module behind its API error state, and avoid cross-module retries from the UI.

slo.latency: p95 <= 1 s for core authenticated reads
slo.measurement: CRM health, targeted smoke and proxy-status checks

modules.rollback: Promote the previous Pages and API artifacts together only when their contract changed; retain database compatibility and disable the affected optional module.

dataOwnership: Ledger, accounts, obligations, movements, imports, access grants and finance audit trail
services: Finance Worker mounted through the API gateway
datastores: D1 finance database with finance_settings and finance_access_grants

featureFlag.enforcement: The API requires an explicit CRM allowedModules grant, a finance_access_grant and module_enabled=true.

modules.fallback: Return FINANCE_DISABLED or FINANCE_MODULE_DENIED without exposing data; retain immutable audit data and use the controlled import/recovery runbook.

slo.latency: p95 <= 1 s for bootstrap and reads
slo.measurement: Authenticated staging smoke with explicit acknowledgement

modules.rollback: Set module_enabled=false, remove pilot grants, stop imports, and restore only through the Finance D1 recovery runbook; migrations remain additive.

dataOwnership: Users, password hashes, sessions, roles, scopes, invitations, recovery grants and identity audit events
services: Identity domain mounted through the compatibility Inventory Worker until independent service promotion
datastores: D1 crm_users, crm_invites, crm_password_resets and crm_user_prefs; legacy insumos_* names remain read-compatible

featureFlag.enforcement: Existing sessions and routes remain active; an independent Identity service cannot receive traffic until an explicit disabled-by-default cutover flag is approved.

modules.fallback: Continue through the compatibility mount against the existing crm_* tables; do not reset passwords, sessions or grants merely to complete a code migration.

slo.measurement: Identity contract tests, gateway tests and auth health evidence

modules.rollback: Return the Inventory compatibility mount to the prior immutable artifact while retaining the same crm_* tables and session cookie format.

dataOwnership: External connector configuration, browser session mechanics and technical job checkpoints; never semantic business records
datastores: Private connector state outside the shared repository

featureFlag.enforcement: Connector activation is per provider; any new automated write path requires a disabled-by-default provider flag and explicit operator approval.

modules.fallback: Stop the connector and hand off the pending item to the semantic owner for manual handling; do not synthesize business data.

slo.latency: bounded by provider timeout and retry policy
slo.measurement: Per-connector execution logs and owner acceptance

modules.rollback: Disable the connector credential/binding, stop retries, and replay only idempotent jobs after the owner confirms the external state.

dataOwnership: Supplies, stock movements, units, inventory audit events and recovery backups
datastores: Cloudflare rate limiter and queue bindings

featureFlag.enforcement: PONTO_INSUMOS_ENABLED controls only the Ponto bridge, not Inventory itself; new Inventory exposure needs a module flag.

modules.fallback: Serve the last safe read state where possible, queue no new mutations during a dependency failure, and use backup recovery for data repair.

slo.latency: p95 <= 800 ms for health and reads
slo.measurement: Inventory API SLO workflow and CRM smoke

modules.rollback: Promote the previous Worker artifact, retain additive D1 migrations, and restore from the documented backup only after write suspension.

dataOwnership: Inbox conversations, channel adapter configuration and message delivery checkpoints
datastores: Channel-engine configured database/cache providers; runtime state is service-owned

featureFlag.enforcement: The provider adapter is disabled unless explicitly enabled in its private runtime configuration.

modules.fallback: Stop outbound automation, retain inbound delivery checkpoints, and escalate to an operator-managed channel without duplicating sends.

slo.measurement: Service health and delivery execution logs

modules.rollback: Disable PROVIDER_ENABLED, return the prior service artifact, and reconcile only messages with provider delivery identifiers.

dataOwnership: Versioned deployment definitions, systemd unit definitions and non-secret runtime path contracts
services: GitHub Actions deployment and verification workflows
datastores: No business database; private runtime state under C:/CodexRuntime is intentionally outside Git

featureFlag.enforcement: Operational changes are released through immutable artifacts and explicit environment approvals, not a module-wide runtime flag.

modules.fallback: Keep the last known-good service definitions and recover through the recorded deployment/version checkpoint.

slo.latency: Health/restart actions complete within documented unit timeout
slo.measurement: Systemd status, deployment evidence and lifecycle validation

modules.rollback: Restore the prior versioned unit/workflow artifact and restart only the affected service after verifying the previous configuration.

dataOwnership: Workflow definitions, schedules, retry checkpoints, operator automation state and review queues

featureFlag.enforcement: Workflows are individually disabled by default; publishing or mutating workflow activation needs explicit owner approval.

modules.fallback: Pause the specific workflow, preserve execution evidence, and route work to an operator; never auto-replay an unknown external mutation.

slo.latency: healthz p95 <= 1 s; job timeout per workflow
slo.measurement: Orb health, service validation and execution status

modules.rollback: Deactivate the affected workflow and restore the prior exported/versioned definition; retain run history for reconciliation.

dataOwnership: Cloudflare resource registry, security token vault records, alert routing configuration and observability contracts

featureFlag.enforcement: Security and observability capabilities are fail-closed; a new public capability must introduce an explicit gated rollout.

modules.fallback: Fail closed for security-sensitive calls and preserve independent application availability where observability is degraded.

slo.measurement: Health probe, Cloudflare audit and security checks

modules.rollback: Promote the preceding immutable Worker version with bindings preserved; do not roll back or expose secret values from D1.

dataOwnership: Clinical treatment delivery and follow-up domain records
services: Domain implementation under service/; no independently deployed service is registered yet
datastores: No independently declared production datastore yet
routes: internal-only; no public route is registered yet

featureFlag.enforcement: This domain is not independently releasable; any first production capability must be feature-flagged disabled by default.

modules.fallback: Keep clinical follow-up in the existing approved operational process until a service contract and safe pilot exist.

slo.availability: No production SLO before first approved release
slo.latency: Defined with the first deployed API

modules.rollback: Disable the first-release flag and return to the approved manual process; do not create irreversible data migration in the first rollout.

dataOwnership: Neutral contracts, SDKs and cross-domain schemas; no product business records
services: Versioned source contracts; no independent deploy unit

featureFlag.enforcement: Shared is a source contract, not a runtime module; consuming modules must gate new externally visible behavior.

modules.fallback: Consumers keep the prior compatible contract until coordinated promotion is complete.
modules.rollback: Revert the shared contract in a compatible release or promote the previous consumer artifacts together.

dataOwnership: Editorial publication jobs, publish locks, shared publication artifacts and social account integration state

featureFlag.enforcement: The Worker refuses publication unless SOCIAL_PUBLISHER_ENABLED=true; jobs are separately controlled by SOCIAL_JOBS_ENABLED.

modules.fallback: Retain drafts/review items and require human publication; no automatic retry may publish after an uncertain provider response.

slo.measurement: Worker health and workflow review evidence

modules.rollback: Set SOCIAL_PUBLISHER_ENABLED=false, promote the previous Worker version, and reconcile publication IDs before any retry.

dataOwnership: Public web content, redirect mappings, consent-safe tracking context and public form input before handoff

featureFlag.enforcement: No site-wide flag exists; new public flows must be guarded by an explicit disabled-by-default flag or remain unpublished.

modules.fallback: Serve the last immutable static/public artifact and preserve a safe manual booking/contact alternative.

slo.latency: p95 <= 1 s for cached public pages
slo.measurement: Site release check, HTTP probe and redirect validation

modules.rollback: Promote the previous immutable Pages/Worker artifact and restore the prior managed redirect snapshot if routing changed.

dataOwnership: Staff schedule, time punches, employee terminal/device context, approvals and timekeeping audit data

featureFlag.enforcement: The facial-punch subfeature is disabled unless explicitly enabled; core timekeeping remains separately protected by authorization and network context.

modules.fallback: Use PIN/terminal and approved manual correction paths; never accept an unverified punch after device/network validation fails.

slo.latency: p95 <= 800 ms for health and punch acknowledgement
slo.measurement: Ponto and Escala smoke workflows plus health probes

modules.rollback: Promote the prior Worker artifact, disable the affected optional capability, and retain additive D1 schema with audited correction/recovery.
